fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6Q58 (CI takes 11-18 minutes per PR). The planner read ci.yml, the Makefile's test target, cmd/rhiza's TestScripts, the budget tests and ship check's rollup parsing, and raised four choices as one question: the intent to serve, how to shard the testscripts, what to do with internal/api once it becomes the critical path, and how the PR keeps one verdict. The arbiter answered with Decision ci-speed-shape: serve milestone-25; shard TestScripts round-robin by RHIZA_TEST_SHARD=i/n over the sorted script names; shard internal/api's top-level tests into 2 jobs by an anchored -run regex; a rest job, a budgets job and a lint job; Makefile targets per job so CI calls make; one workflow with fail-fast false, setup-go caching keyed on go.sum, and an aggregate job named check under if: always() that fails unless every job succeeded; ship check unchanged unless a test shows otherwise. No owner words were typed in this run.
fields.title: CI speed plan, autonomous interview with the arbiter
